# gitlab — 2013 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 8 gitlab CVEs of 2013 are in `data/cve/vendors/gitlab/2013.jsonl`.

### CVE-2013-4490
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2014-05-13 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 34362: Gitlab-shell - Code Execution (Metasploit) (remote/linux, 2014-08-19, verified=1)

The SSH key upload feature (lib/gitlab_keys.rb) in gitlab-shell before 1.7.3, as used in GitLab 5.0 before 5.4.1 and 6.x before 6.2.3, allows remote authenticated users to execute arbitrary commands via shell metacharacters in the public key.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

References:
- https://www.gitlab.com/2013/11/04/gitlab-ce-6-2-and-5-4-security-release/ [x_refsource_CONFIRM]

### CVE-2013-7316
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2014-01-24 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 30329: Gitlab 6.0 - Persistent Cross-Site Scripting (webapps/php, 2013-12-16, verified=1)

Cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in GitLab 6.0 and other versions before 6.5.0 allows remote attackers to inject arbitrary web script or HTML via a crafted HTML file, as demonstrated by README.html.
